The Switch Program

Done With Your Slow MSP?

Switch to GigitekAI and get our 60-Day Migration Guarantee. We handle everything — zero downtime, zero risk. If we don't deliver, the migration is on us.

Start My Free IT Audit Call (727) 382-6909

Sound Familiar?

If you're experiencing any of these with your current MSP, it's time to switch.

✕Waiting 4+ hours for a callback on critical issues
✕Paying per-ticket fees that punish you for having problems
✕Your MSP doesn't understand Florida's FIPA or hurricane risks
✕No proactive monitoring — they only show up when things break
✕Slow response times that cost you real revenue
✕No AI or automation — still doing everything manually

How the Switch Works

Four simple steps. Zero disruption to your business.

01

Free IT Audit

We assess your current environment, identify gaps, and build a migration plan — at no cost to you.

02

Zero-Downtime Migration

Our team handles the full migration. Your users keep working. No weekend outages, no lost data.

03

60-Day Guarantee

If we don't deliver the agreed service quality within 60 days, your migration is completely free.

04

AI-Powered Onboarding

Aria, our AI agent, trains on your environment and starts resolving tickets from day one.

Our Guarantees to You
